Invalid escape or dangling backslash raises ValueError. No imports or external dependencies. Return full solution.py in files, with only pure functions; allowed built-ins len/range/enumerate/zip/sorted/list/tuple/str/int/float/bool/abs/min/max/sum/round/ValueError; the only allowed method call is list.append. Do not include grading tests. answer may briefly identify the implementation. Host checks run separately. Inputs are strings, at most80 characters.

response.concise_method_summary: Parse fields left to right. Commas delimit fields unless escaped; a backslash must be followed by either a comma or another backslash. Append each completed field, preserving empty and trailing fields.
assumptions: A backslash escapes exactly the next comma or backslash.
ValueError message text is not prescribed.
Whitespace and all non-comma, non-backslash characters are literal field content.
proposed_verification: Check dangling and invalid escapes raise ValueError.
